author: Inside Edition
description: Police were told that an intruder stabbed Christine Banfield to death and her husband, Brendan Banfield shot the intruder dead. The family's au pair initially told police she saw the killer repeatedly stab Christine, but Wednesday, the au pair testified that story was a lie, and she was part of a plot to kill the wife. Authorities learned that Brendan and the au pair were lovers. The au pair has pled guilty to manslaughter and is the star witness against Brendan. Brendan denied any wrongdoing.
title: Au Pair Testifies About Alleged Murder Plot In Brendan Banfield Trial

author: Inside Edition
description: DB Cooper became an American folk hero for supposedly "sticking it to the man" after parachuting out of a plane in 1971 with $200,000 in cash, never to be seen again. He triggered an epidemic of hijackings in the 1960s and 70s. Martin McNally was one of the hijackers who says he was inspired by Cooper. In 1972, McNally commanded an America Airlines flight then jumped out of the plane with $502,000, the equivalent of $4 million. His story is the subject of a new documentary "American Skyjacker."
title: New Documentary Tells Story Of DB Cooper Copycat, Martin McNally

author: Inside Edition
description: Actor Timothy Busfield's lawyers tell Inside Edition Busfield "denies the allegations in a criminal complaint and maintains they are completely false." Busfield is married to actress Melissa Gilbert. Police allege Busfield "engages in unlawful sexual conduct with twin brothers" on the set of the TV show "The Cleaning Lady" which ran on Fox and which Busfield directed from 2022 to 2025.
title: Actor Timothy Busfield Denies Child Sex Abuse Charges

author: Inside Edition
description: John Brittingham was driving his car when he saw two toddlers on a busy highway in Cocoa Beach, Florida. Brittingham pulled over and waved to alert drivers that the twin girls were in the middle of the highway. He scooped up the toddlers and carried them to safety on the sidewalk. Brittingham says he found the girls' family at an AirBnB they were staying in. The father of five and grandfather of three spoke with Inside Edition's Alison Hall.
title: Man Saves Twin Toddlers Found On Busy Highway

author: Inside Edition
description: Golden Globes host Nikki Glaser got the crowd laughing throughout the show. She revealed she had other zingers up her sleeve that were too mean for television. The comedian told Howard Stern some of the jokes were too edgy for the A-list audience. Glaser had cracks for Sydney Sweeney and Brad Pitt, who both did not go to the big show, that were cut. Glaser also revealed the one joke she was nervous to tell, but told anyway.
title: Nikki Glaser Reveals Jokes That Were Too Mean For Golden Globes Show

author: Inside Edition
description: This fight for dominance was over before it started, but this rhino thought it would humor this little deer. Video of the showdown was taken at the Wroclaw Zoo in Poland. Staff says Marusia the rhino strayed a little too close to the deer's territory while a female was in heat.
title: Tiny Deer Charges At Rhino For Getting Too Close #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: Claudette Colvin was just 15 years old in 1955 when she boarded a segregated bus in Montgomery, Alabama. She was told to move to the back of the bus. When she refused to give up her seat, she was arrested. Colvin became one of the plaintiffs in a lawsuit challenging racial segregation on Montgomery's buses. Her arrest came several months before Rosa Parks was also arrested for the same thing. Colvin's family announced her death on Tuesday.
title: Civil Rights Pioneer Claudette Colvin Dies At 86

author: Inside Edition
description: The new HBO Max documentary "The Cult Behind The Killer" is raising questions about the Andrea Yates case.
title: Where Has Andrea Yates Been Living Since Her Trial? #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: The former college professor spoke out in her first interview since her acquittal last summer.
title: Why Was Karen Read 'Depressed' On Day Of Acquittal? #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: Hi Barbie! This is the newest member of the fashion icon's crew and she has autism. Mattel says it worked with the Autistic Self Advocacy Network for more than a year to create a doll that represented the community. She has a side gaze, unlike traditional Barbies that look straight on. This Barbie comes with headphones, a tablet and other accessories that many people with autism use to help them navigate the world. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Newest Barbie Doll Has Autism And Carries Around Helpful Accessories

title: Actor Timothy Busfield Turns Himself In To Authorities #shorts
